All applicants must take a Swedish language proficiency test issued by the government migration agency’s facilities nearest them, failing the test means a rejection of one's application.

Even though a large majority of Sweden is highly proficient in English, it is important that foreigners who want to become Swedish learn the language as it is a very important part of what it means to be one of us.
